Tengam with its electrons swapped for positrons is literally §9antipolarised§r. Field-cooling it locks the reversed domains, and its counter-currents untwist a magnetar's field.

§5§lCHAIN§r
1. Raw Tengam → Electromagnetic Separator → Purified Tengam → Polarizer → §9Attuned Tengam dust§r.
2. §9Large Chemical Reactor§r (UXV, 20 s): 16 Attuned Tengam dust + 100 L Semi-Stable Antimatter + 144 L molten SpaceTime →§9 1,000 L Positronic Tengam Slurry§r.
3. §9Vacuum Freezer§r (UXV, 10 s): 1,000 L slurry + 2,000 L Super Coolant →§9 1,000 L Antipolarization Agent§r.
Semi-Stable Antimatter comes from the Antimatter Forge (SSASS).

§5§lUSE§r
- the magnetar's §9constant feed§r, 3,000 L a cycle (50 L/s);
- the Magnetar Merger charge, 100,000 L;
- the Magnetar Seed Core, 64,000 L (as its condensate);
- the flare shield trim.

§5§lAUTOMATE§r One reactor at UXV makes 50 L/s, exactly the feed. Run two, chained to the freezer through ME, to cover the shield trims and the next merger charge.

[note]The Eye returns §l12 §ldust§r of Purified Tengam per 1,000 L of Agent burned (75 % of the Tengam), so antimatter is the real cost.[/note]

§2§lDONE §lWHEN§r you hold 1,000 L of Antipolarization Agent.
